messages:
Harper: FYI noticed invoice-preview showing ~2x token counts for tenant 'inkworks' starting right after the routing shadowing experiment was enabled in the canary. Live invoices (post-settlement) look normal. Link: https://console/redwood/invoice-preview/tenant/inkworks :confused:
Jin: same pattern here. Preview uses the ingest stream before the dedupe step; shadowed requests are mirrored by the proxy with header `X-Shadow: 1` and end up double-counted in preview. Live pipeline dedupes later by event_id, so final invoices are ok.
canary-bot: Canary started route-proxy-shadow:v1 -> 7% (id=cr-2026-03-22-020) at 1715601000
shadow-bot: sample raw: { tenant: "inkworks", tokens: 320, event_id: "e-774", X-Shadow: 1, trace: "t-33" } and mirrored primary event { tenant: "inkworks", tokens: 320, event_id: "e-774", X-Shadow: 0, trace: "t-33" } both arrive at preview-ingest.
Omar: quick check: how many events have identical event_id but different shadow header in the last 30m?
Jin: running query: ```SELECT event_id, count(*) as cnt, tenant FROM preview_ingest WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' GROUP BY event_id, tenant HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 50;```
Jin: result: several hundred dupes, majority tied to tenants under the canary window. inkworks shows ~1,280 duplicate event_ids matching the canary start time.
Leila: UX ask: console invoice-preview should have a small badge/warning when pre-dedupe duplicate rate > 0.5% with tooltip: "Preview includes shadowed events; final invoice may differ." Also offer a toggle "Exclude shadowed events from preview (experimental)".
Harper: mitigation options: (A) Preview pipeline: ignore events with header `X-Shadow: 1` (fast), (B) Add a preview-side early-dedupe by event_id/checksum (safer but heavier), (C) Change proxy to add `X-Shadow-ID` rather than duplicating event_id so dedupe can run correctly. Thoughts?
Jin: (A) is easiest for immediate clarity but hides shadow coverage from preview; (B) expensive at high throughput but closest to parity with live; (C) requires coordination with several teams and a rollout. I'd do (A) + plan B as follow-up.
Omar: we should instrument metric metering.preview.duplicate_rate and metering.preview.shadowed_rate per-tenant. Alert if duplicate_rate > 0.2% over 10m. Also gate canary ramps on shadowed_rate < 0.1%. Example rollout clause: ```rollout_checks: - metric: metering.preview.shadowed_rate window: 600 threshold_pct: 0.1 action: hold```
Leila: I'll add the badge and toggle mock to the invoice-preview page. UX note: when toggle is ON, show IN-PREVIEW estimate and LIVE-PREDICTION estimate side-by-side. Filing ticket #1517.
shadow-bot: After applying filter on staging (ignore X-Shadow=1), preview dupes for inkworks dropped from 1,280 -> 8 in a 15m sample.
Harper: good short-term. Jin, can you put up a PR to make preview-ingest ignore X-Shadow=1? Also add a sampling sink that stores a small fraction of shadowed events for debugging.
Jin: PR opened: https://git/repo/pull/1525 - preview-ingest: drop events where header X-Shadow=1 unless debug flag set. Also added sampling sink at 0.1%.
Omar: follow-ups: (1) preview filter PR (Jin), (2) early-dedupe perf analysis and P0/P1 plan (Jin+Infra), (3) console badge + toggle (Leila), (4) metric + alert + rollout gating (Omar). Owners assigned.
Leila: will also add a small helptext link "Why preview differs from final invoice" and include a bullet about shadowing experiments.
Harper: canary-bot: marking canary paused until preview.shadowed_rate < 0.1% and we have preview filter merged.
canary-bot: Canary paused for route-proxy-shadow:v1 (cr-2026-03-22-020) - hold reason: preview duplication exceeded gating threshold
Jin: note for backfill: don't backfill to correct preview; backfill could confuse customers since live already deduped. Instead we should produce a reconciled report that shows "preview vs final" diffs for the affected window and surface to billing team. I'll prepare a dry-run report.
Harper: agreed. Documenting lesson: any proxy shadowing must be accompanied by preview parity plan (ignore, dedupe, or explicit markup) and a metric to prevent surprise. Will add to rollout playbook checklist.
Leila: closing thread; will post PR link + badge mock once ready.
